import sqlite3,pathlib,json,datetime
p=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/.ontrack-saas/ontrack-console.sqlite')
if not p.is_file(): raise RuntimeError('database missing')
db=sqlite3.connect(str(p),timeout=6,isolation_level=None)
db.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=6000')
try:
 db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
 row=db.execute("""SELECT d.id,d.account_id,d.site_id,d.agent_id,d.sim_slot,d.status,
 a.status,s.status,ag.status
 FROM device_bindings d JOIN accounts a ON a.id=d.account_id
 JOIN sites s ON s.id=d.site_id AND s.account_id=d.account_id
 JOIN agents ag ON ag.id=d.agent_id AND ag.site_id=d.site_id AND ag.account_id=d.account_id
 WHERE d.id=?""",(1,)).fetchone()
 if row!=(1,1,6,6,0,'active','active','active','archived'):
  raise RuntimeError('Binding changed since read-only audit; no changes')
 candidate=db.execute("""SELECT ag.id FROM agents ag JOIN agent_flow_versions v
 ON v.agent_id=ag.id AND v.site_id=ag.site_id AND v.account_id=ag.account_id
 WHERE ag.id=? AND ag.account_id=? AND ag.site_id=? AND ag.status='published'
 LIMIT 1""",(7,1,6)).fetchone()
 if not candidate: raise RuntimeError('New agent not published in the same tenant/site')
 updated=db.execute("""UPDATE device_bindings SET agent_id=7
 WHERE id=1 AND account_id=1 AND site_id=6 AND sim_slot=0 AND agent_id=6 AND status='active'""")
 if updated.rowcount!=1: raise RuntimeError('Concurrent change; rollback')
 detail=json.dumps({'binding_id':1,'sim_slot':0,'from_agent_id':6,'to_agent_id':7,'reason':'archived agent, same-account published agent','preserved':'device token and SIM identity'})
 db.execute('INSERT INTO audit_events(actor_user_id,account_id,action,detail,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(None,1,'device.binding.repaired',detail,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')))
 db.commit()
 print(json.dumps({'result':'SIM1_BINDING_REPAIRED','binding_id':1,'agent_id':7,'sim_slot':0,'token_unchanged':True,'published_agent':True}))
except:
 db.rollback()
 raise
finally: db.close()
